licence.terms: No terms of use are stated on the NWP SAF SRF pages or in the files. The NWP SAF SRF index lists sensors whose 'SRFs cannot be published due to licence restrictions' separately; this sensor's SRFs are published there.
licence.scope: EUMETSAT NWP SAF distribution of originator data (see notes). Hosted under Nill's 2026-10-26 'host everything' decision.

notes: NWP SAF README_SRF: 'Data obtained from Beijing Normal University (BNU) Date received: 30/09/2025 SRF flt file contains the frequency (GHz) and the normalised real numbers (between 0-1)' Held, not hosted (curve extends below 15 GHz, beyond the NJM validator limit of 2e8 A): ch01 (10.644 GHz V (ID=3)): curve reaches 10.544 GHz < 14.99 GHz; ch02 (10.653 GHz H (ID=4)): curve reaches 10.555 GHz < 14.99 GHz. Zeros added just inside gaps between separate passbands. Pivots agree with the page's central frequencies within 1% except double-sideband channels, whose pivot lies between the sidebands. DetectorType energy is assumed.
